question: Does the paper report the performance of the model for each individual language?
title: X-Stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
answer_rationale: The paper reports performance for each individual language by evaluating zero-shot cross-lingual transfer and using multilingual BERT, which is trained and tested across languages including English, Swiss Standard German, French, and Italian. The evaluation includes language-specific test sets and performance metrics for each language.
